summary: A strong drama-first opening beat: physical hardship establishes the men, Shalabi’s answer turns the race into a statement of command, and the parade-ground joke pivots the victory toward war without losing warmth. Performances and military behavior are credible, with only two minor pronunciation marks and one slightly explicit foreshadowing line.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Project down the moving file over splashing and heavy breathing. He is driving trained men, not delivering a parade-ground slogan.

lines.text: يَلَّا يَا رِجَّالَةْ! السَّرِيَّةْ التَّانْيَةْ سَابْقَانَا بِدِقِيقْتِينْ!

lines.speaker: ADEL

performance.delivery: Speak only to Mostafa while fighting for breath. Let the joke fall out dryly, without setting up a punchline.

lines.text: دِقِيقْتِينْ إِيهْ… دَانَا رِجْلَيَّا بِقِتْ مِلْحْ.

performance.delivery: Hold Mostafa close by the webbing and make the distinction coldly clear. The restraint should feel more serious than another shout.

lines.speaker: MOSTAFA
issues: Bare «فَاهِمْ» is less regulation than «فَاهِمْ يَا فَنْدِمْ», but the omission is credible while he is spitting out brine.

performance.delivery: Force the word out between breaths after spitting away the salt water. Do not sound sulky; he knows Sayed is right.

lines.speaker: SAYED

performance.delivery: Report to Shalabi while still recovering his breath. He is fishing for acknowledgment without openly asking for it.

lines.text: أَوِّلْ رَاجِلْ عَدَّى مِنْ بَدْرِي يَا فَنْدِمْ.

performance.delivery: Keep watching the last man and answer without looking at Sayed. The line means the unit finishes together, but do not explain that meaning.

lines.speaker: COMMANDER

performance.delivery: Read the result across the parade ground with seasoned authority. Give the company designation and Shalabi’s name equal official weight, with no celebratory flourish.

lines.text: أَكْفَأْ سَرِيَّةْ… السَّرِيَّةْ الْأُولَى. النَّقِيبْ حَمْدِي شَلَبِي.

lines.speaker: MAHMOUD
issues: The plural «عَارْفِينْ» requires Mahmoud to be quietly addressing more than Adel; the blocking should make that clear.

performance.delivery: Keep his head and body rigid in ranks and move only his lips. He wants to share the warning but is afraid of being caught talking.
Answer without turning, as if he genuinely wants this to be the reward. Keep it dry and small rather than playing broadly for comedy.

lines.speaker: MAHMOUD
issues: «أَتْقَلْ مُهِمَّةْ هَتِتْرِمِي عَلِينَا» makes the foreshadowing explicit, though it remains plausible soldier talk.

performance.delivery: Give Adel the answer quietly while remaining motionless in formation. Land the final words as a practical conclusion, not a prophecy.

lines.text: يَعْنِي أَوِّلْ مَا الْحَرْبْ تِقُومْ… أَتْقَلْ مُهِمَّةْ هَتِتْرِمِي عَلِينَا.

performance.delivery: Do not turn or break attention. Cut both men off with the minimum breath, showing that he heard every whispered word.
